messages:
kyle: Pushing perf numbers from the FP8 experiment. Quick summary: fused-attn-v2 + per-layer bitmasking gives 1.9x throughput on seq512 but we saw a weird spike in tail latency after 10k requests.
anya: Can you paste the profiler trace? suspect KV cache misses or kernel fallback.
kyle: Paste below, trimmed:
```
GPU cycles: 6.8e12
attn_kernel_fused_v2: 64% cycles
int8_dispatch: 18% (with fallback to fp32 6% of time)
kv_page_faults: 210
```
sheng: kv_page_faults 210 is high for warm cache. Are we evicting too aggressively with the new batching heuristic?
eva: We're using batch_budget=120ms per request window now (experiment). That increases batch sizes but also pushes memory churn.
anya: Did we run calibration with the same prompt distribution? FP8 dynamic range calibration matters a lot for emb/lm_head.
kyle: Calibration set was 2k prompts from webqa, but embeddings were included. miss: we should exclude embeddings & lm_head from FP8 quant.
sheng: Agreed — embedding vectors are highly dynamic; 8-bit scaling caused saturation. Suggest per-layer exclude list: embeddings, lm_head, layers 6,7,9 identified as sensitive.
eva: How are we encoding the per-layer mask in the runtime? current proto expects a comma list. we could switch to compact bitmask to avoid parsing cost.
kyle: Implemented a bitmask to toggle quant mode per layer. Rough config example:
```
quant_layer_mask: 111110011111...  # 1=quantize, 0=force-fp
exclude_names: ["embeddings", "lm_head"]
```
anya: Smart. Also need to adjust kernel selection: prefer int8-fused when mask says quantized, but have immediate fallback to fp16 kernels on any scale overflow instead of jumping to fp32 — that reduced tail latency a lot in other tests.
sheng: Can we change fallback policy to prefer lower-precision fallback (int8 -> fp16 -> fp32) rather than directly fp32? hardware supports fast fp16 paths on A100.
eva: Yes. We measured tail latency drop ~35% when avoiding fp32 fallback. But quality — ppl increased slightly in some tasks.
kyle: Quality regressed on a small set (translation prompts). PPL delta +0.9. We should run a focused eval with per-layer calibration: calibrate scaling constants ignoring embeddings and force fp16 for softmax layers.
anya: Also look at KV cache behavior: when layermask flips at runtime (we allow dynamic retires for canary), we saw KV cache invalidation triggering because tensor layout changes — need to keep cache key format stable across quant modes.
kyle: Good catch. We'll ensure KV cache key includes (model_version, layer_mask_hash) so cache separation avoids silent corruption.
sheng: Plan for rollout:
- canary 2% with bitmask + int8->fp16 fallback, exclude embeddings & lm_head
- monitor gpu_cycles, kv_page_faults, p95 latency, and eval PPL on calibration set
- auto-rollback if p95 increases >10% or PPL +1.5
anya: I'll hook this into the console alerting and create dashboards for per-layer kernel dispatch counts.
eva: One more thing — batching heuristic: try a hybrid budget that caps both time (120ms) and token-window (max 2048 tokens) to prevent runaway memory churn.
kyle: OK I'll land kernel selection change and mask support. PR will include unit tests for mask parsing + fallback policy. ETA tomorrow EOD.
perf-bot: deploy-check: new-tests: 78 passed, 2 flaky (quantization_unit_test)
anya: Thanks — ping me when PR is up, will start canary config.
sheng: :eyes:
